purpose: Benchmark the Java psychometrics-irt (jMetrik library) 4PL MML estimator against PR #145/#146 evidence on one fixture. Numerical only; no Monte Carlo unless every gate passes.

source.license: Apache-2.0 (Java file headers and pom <licenses>; a stale GPL notice in pom.xml header is recorded)
source.used_as: external binary in CI only; no source copied into PsikoAnaliz

inspection.estimator: MarginalMaximumLikelihoodEstimation: EM; per-item M-step with DefaultUncminOptimizer (unconstrained quasi-Newton, Dennis-Schnabel), stopping on max parameter change
inspection.bounds: none in the optimizer; Irm4PL.probability clips to [0,1] and ItemLogLikelihood clips to [EPS,1-EPS]
inspection.priors: optional; the only 4PL estimation test in the repo (pl4Test) is disabled and uses Beta4 priors (MAP)

run: one bounded execution: Irm4PL(a=1,b=0,c=.05,d=.95,D=1), NO priors (ML), StartingValues, latent N(0,1) on the same GH61 nodes/weights, estimateParameters(converge=1e-6, maxIter=2000)
unavoidable_differences: no box constraints (our ML uses a[.1,5], b[-6,6], c[0,.5], d[.5,1]); probability clipping; parameter-change stopping rule
gates: identical to validation/four_pl_engine/PROTOCOL.json gates_per_engine (common evaluator; projected raw score <= 1e-5 on GH61 and GH161 audit, |dlogLik GH161| <= 1e-3, PD information, condition <= 1e8) plus all estimates inside the common bounds
decision: PASS -> run the smallest separately preregistered recovery experiment (not SE/CI). FAIL -> record the blocker; no threshold relaxation, no seed or optimizer search, no adapter, no production switch.
